synopsis: The Official Journal serves as the publication venue for EU legislation and for Commission references to harmonized standards developed by CEN and CENELEC [f2372, f15077]. Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, the Digital Omnibus on AI, was adopted on 8 July 2026, published on 24 July 2026 and entered into force on 27 July 2026; Chapter 3 attributes the publication date to law-firm summaries [f9796, f2372]. However, the detailed Digital Omnibus machinery provisions, including the AI Act machinery carve-out and delegated-act mechanism, rely on secondary summaries rather than reviewed Official Journal text [f9801, f10309]. The cited Annex I items of Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 were also not reviewed in the Official Journal, leaving a separate primary-source verification gap for planning [f9795].

relations.note: Both give 24 July 2026 as the regulation’s Official Journal publication date.
Both identify secondary-source reliance and missing Official Journal review for machinery provisions.
